_note: Retrieval gold set for recall@k. A passage counts as a hit when its source matches and its text contains every string in 'contains' (case-insensitive). IDs starting with A/B/C/D/E are eval-set queries the openFDA corpus can support; R-items are extra retrieval probes. Each condition was checked to match at least one passage in the corpus built on 2026-11-25.
